PREPLANNING_CONTEXT: preplanning_complete

## Story Map (13 stories total)

### Foundation Layer (unblocks all Enhancement stories)
- 9fee-6947 (P1): Corpus directory, schema, manifest, ref-query.sh, shim, provenance — covers sc-1, sc-2, sc-3, sc-6, sc-7

### SC-3 Optional Accelerator
- 40a2-d037 (P2): bm25s accelerator + stdlib BM25 fallback — covers sc-3

### SC-4 Content Domains (all depend on 9fee-6947)
- f5bd-27a9 (P1): 48 gov anti-patterns — covers sc-4(e)
- 5a09-615c (P1): WCAG 2.2 accessibility — covers sc-4(c)
- c642-4840 (P2): Dark patterns + behavioral/cognitive — covers sc-4(e)+(f)
- 6c26-4321 (P2): Design heuristics + principles — covers sc-4(d)
- fab0-d0e2 (P1): USWDS components + tokens — covers sc-4(g)
- 4670-5845 (P1): gov-benefit-flows domain (one-question-per-page, task lists, SNAP lifecycle) — covers sc-4(a)+(b) [NEW - sc-4 coverage gap]
- c5f7-bfe8 (P2): Agentic UI patterns (multi-level transparency, human-in-the-loop) — covers sc-4(i) [NEW - sc-4 coverage gap]

### SC-8 Gov-Copy Domain (Foundation + Enhancement split)
- bdb4-3211 (P1): Federal-style-canon Foundation (USWDS, GOV.UK, VA.gov) — covers sc-8 partial; depends on 9fee-6947 + cfa6-6c7f [NEW]
- edbb-67aa (P2): Federal-style-canon Enhancement (18F, FPLG, CDC) — covers sc-8 complete; depends on bdb4-3211 [NEW]

### SC-5 Integration Verification
- cfa6-6c7f (P1): Integration test suite (6 sub-tests including precision) — covers sc-5

### Documentation
- 5dcc-7811 (P3): Update CLAUDE.md and KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## SC Coverage Matrix
- sc-1: 9fee-6947
- sc-2: 9fee-6947
- sc-3: 9fee-6947 (stdlib BM25) + 40a2-d037 (bm25s accelerator)
- sc-4: f5bd-27a9 + 5a09-615c + c642-4840 + 6c26-4321 + fab0-d0e2 + 4670-5845 + c5f7-bfe8
- sc-5: cfa6-6c7f
- sc-6: 9fee-6947
- sc-7: 9fee-6947
- sc-8: bdb4-3211 (Foundation) + edbb-67aa (Enhancement)

## Walking Skeleton
9fee-6947 is the walking skeleton — delivers corpus directory, schema, manifest, query interface. All content stories depend on it.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked (non-interactive default applied).

## Adversarial Review Summary (Phase E)
Red team (11 findings) -> blue team filter -> 7 surviving findings applied:
- 2 new stories created: gov-benefit-flows (4670-5845) and agentic patterns (c5f7-bfe8) for sc-4 gaps
- draft-1 split into Foundation/Enhancement slices (bdb4-3211 + edbb-67aa)
- DDs for bdb4-3211 name all sources explicitly and enforce rule_id/prior_art/precedence at schema layer
- bdb4-3211 depends on cfa6-6c7f (integration tests gate precision assertion)
- Licensing consideration applied to bdb4-3211 and edbb-67aa DDs
- Domain-namespace reservation consideration added to 9fee-6947
- 6 sub-tests enumerated in cfa6-6c7f planning consideration
